# Notifications (`services/notifications/`)

Per-user in-app notifications (migration 954 `user_notifications`; budgets P5-1). Read by the header bell (`src/components/layout/NotificationBell.tsx`) through `GET /api/accounting/notifications` and `POST /api/accounting/notifications/read`.

## Caller contract
- `listNotifications(companyId, userId)` → `{ items: latest 20, newest first; unread }`. `markRead(companyId, userId, { ids } | { all: true })` → `{ updated }` (only the caller's own unread rows; others' ids are ignored). `notifyUsers(companyId, userIds, { kind, refId, title, body, href, dedupeKey })` → `{ skipped }`; one row per user per dedupe key, a rerun writes nothing.
- Every query names company AND user. RLS also limits app_user's reads/updates to `user_id = auth.uid()`, but the service pool's mirrors are USING (true), so the query must hold alone (tested as app_service).
- Writing for OTHER users as app_user: `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` with NO conflict target and NO `RETURNING`. Either one makes Postgres check the new row against the read policy and the insert fails 42501.
- `href` is an in-app path only (`src/lib/inAppPath.ts`, same rule as the table CHECK: no scheme, no `//` or `/\`, no control character or white space anywhere, since a URL parser strips tab/LF/CR); the bell never follows anything else.
- Recipients must be members of the company: the table's trigger refuses others (23503) via `public.user_notification_recipient_ok` (company_users as the caller sees it, else 714's reviewed definer for a manager notifying an owner); `notifyUsers` asks the same function first, skips (logs and returns `{ skipped }`) any id that is no longer a member and writes the rest. From a request only an owner, admin or manager may send (trigger, 42501); the service pool with no claims may. Title/body are fitted (trimmed, NUL dropped, 200 / 2 000 code points); a blank title or a dedupe key outside 1-200 is an Error.
- The cron's role: the service pool's login `isaflow_service` (inherits `app_service`, no claims). It inserts through 915's mirrors; membership is read directly from company_users (tested in budgets-p5-notifications / budgets-p5-schema-r2).
- Bell (`NotificationBell.tsx`): refetches on the window event `isaflow:notifications-changed` (`@/lib/notificationsSignal`; Evaluate now sends it), through the same sequence check; no fetch without an active company; a stale response (older sequence number) is dropped; a failed refresh keeps the last good list and badge beside the error; the panel is a non-modal dialog that takes focus and gives it back to the bell on Escape.
- `kind` ∈ budget_alert | budget_slice | budget_reminder (table CHECK). Producers: P5-4 alerts, P5-6 slices/reminders.
